private.name: Rainmaker
private.rationale: Same sector (Drones & Autonomous), same stage (Series A)

data.narrative:
Seneca, a Series A autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, is the subject of this valuation. The broader comp universe comprises eight private firms operating in the same sector, including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro; no direct public comparables exist in this early-stage frontier technology space.

Given the absence of a sufficiently sized narrow peer set at the same stage and valuation tier, the Peer-Median method was not applicable. Instead, Stage-Progression analysis was employed, using Seneca's $60M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage step-ups. This method yielded an implied valuation of $120M.

The triangulated valuation range is $102M to $138M, with a median of $120M. This range reflects conservative sensitivity around the stage-progression multiplier but is constrained by the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the appropriate multiplier calibration absent granular peer revenue or growth metrics, and the true market positioning of Seneca relative to the broader autonomous systems landscape. Additional financial and operational data from peer companies at comparable stages would strengthen conviction in this range.
